premises.text: Most retail sales still happen in stores that lack online-style personalized recommendations and rich data
premises.evidence_span: 95% of sales still comes from brick-and-mortar stores

premises.text: Brands see in-store purchases as anonymous transactions without shopper personality or intent
premises.evidence_span: to all of them, it looks like different transactions. But there's no personality behind it

premises.text: POS-linked personalization sends receipts with recommended products matched to shopper profiles
premises.evidence_span: we leverage the point of sales system

premises.text: Visual analytics dashboard shows sales performance, growth drivers, and individual customer profiles so brands know what to fix
premises.evidence_span: turn those numbers into a really visual dashboard and an easy way for brands to tell not only how their sales are doing, but what they can do about it

premises.text: Start with mid-to-high luxury standalone fashion brands that prioritize customer experience
premises.evidence_span: individual brands in the mid to high luxury tier fashion retailer

value.text: Personalize the brick-and-mortar retail store experience

secondary_value.text: Help brands know who likes what when shoppers walk in
secondary_value.evidence_span: When people walk into the store, how do you know who's who?

causal_links.evidence_span: You don't get any of that rich data when you walk into a store
a customer profile for your customers

notes: Independent run: beachhead segment folded into product domain rather than singleton GTM. Dashboard demo details one analytics premise. Market-size framing excluded.
